scope: Corollary 3.6 of the manuscript “Continuous Phase Foliations Create Analytic Caustic Collars” (preprints/Continuous-Phase-Foliations-Create-Analytic-Caustic-Collars-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 147 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 357beeb0c0854e26), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the actual table, D = Du is real symmetric and holomorphic in a uniform neighborhood of the real diagonal. It is diagonally 2π-periodic and antisymmetric, and satisfies D(x, x + b) = − b3 24 + O(b5 ), D1(x, x + b) = b2 8 + O(b4 ), (3.17) locally uniformly with each fixed number of derivatives.
